City of Brantford Open Data Hub

Updated April 2026, with a new design and updated links to ensure the public has access to our datasets

settings.markdown: We are pleased to provide a free and open data portal where citizens, developers, communities, and agencies with an interest in geospatial and tabular data can discover a variety of municipal datasets we’re making available. Please take the opportunity to browse, search, preview, and download the data in multiple popular formats.
Environment Parks and Recreation Transportation Land Use and Development Base Data Data Catalog

Using This Site

Use the search bar at the top of the page to find data relating to topics of interest. As you browse through the different datasets, the extent of each will be displayed on the map. Once you find what you are looking for, select the dataset from the list to be able to view the data and get options for download.

You can also view our complete list of datasets.

Accessing The Data

There are several ways to access the data within. The data can be downloaded as shapefiles or KML for GIS applications, and as CSV for tables and spreadsheets. Advanced users may also integrate our data into other applications.

Learn more about using this data portal.

Developers

Data from this site can be easily embedded in other applications using the GeoService or GeoJSON links.
Explore the ESRI JavaScript API documentation to get started.
